footer.tagline: KUN Visual Novel Stickers — a sticker platform anyone can publish to

about.title: About
about.lead: Stickers captured from visual novels. Any NextMoe account can publish a pack.

what.heading: What this is
lines: A pack is a set of stickers. Each sticker can name the visual novel it came from and the character it shows.
The first seven packs were put together by the site owner; they now sit in the same catalogue as everyone else's.

publish.heading: Publishing
publish.intro: Sign in with a NextMoe account and it takes a few steps:
steps: Create a pack and give it a title.
Upload images — you can select several at once.
Label each sticker with its character and visual novel, and drag to reorder.

rules.heading: Rules
items: Keep it related to visual novels.
Mark packs with adult content as R18.
Respect the original artists; do not upload material that forbids redistribution.
Rule-breaking packs are hidden or removed.

items.q: How many stickers fit in one pack?
items.a: 80, the same as a typical messenger sticker set.
png, jpeg and webp, up to 10MB each. Everything is converted to webp on upload.

items.q: Can I download a whole pack?
items.a: Yes — "Download pack" on the pack page gives you a zip.

items.q: Can I edit a pack after publishing?
items.a: Yes. Unpublishing makes it private again; publish once you are happy.

open.heading: Open source
open.body: The site is open source. A public API is planned and will be offered through the nextmoe developer platform.
